'''Dominick''' (Japanese: '''トモノ''' ''Tomono'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG127|From Brags to Riches]]''. He is a [[Pokémon Trainer]] from [[Inua Town]] who took part in the [[Double Battle]] rounds of the [[Ever Grande Conference]].

Dominick was one of {{Ash}}'s opponents during the conference. He sent out his {{p|Tropius}} and {{p|Swalot}} against Ash's {{AP|Torkoal}} and {{AP|Corphish}}. While {{p|Corphish}} tried to flood Swalot with {{m|Bubble Beam}}, {{p|Torkoal}} and Tropius went at each other with {{m|Overheat}} and {{m|Flamethrower}} and {{m|Bullet Seed}} and {{m|Solar Beam}}, respectively. Tropius kept on flying while Torkoal kept using {{m|Iron Defense}} to shield itself. Eventually, both Pokémon ended up knocking each other out.

No matter what attack Corphish unleashed on Swalot, from its Bubble Beam to its {{m|Crabhammer}}, the {{type|Poison}} absorbed all of them. Swalot was also capable of fighting back with its {{m|Sludge Bomb}} and {{m|Shock Wave}}. Finally, Corphish was capable of protecting itself from the Shock Wave by using its pincers before using Bubble Beam inside of Swalot's mouth. Sure enough, Swalot was sent flying from all of the water inside of it. Ash was declared the victor and moved on to his next battle. Dominick was eliminated from the tournament.
